verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say AI agents can interact with Drata to automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language, and an official MCP server setup guide exists. Natural-language operation therefore goes through an external AI agent connected to Drata's MCP server, and the pack documents it only thinly. missing for 10: an in-product natural-language interface, details of which operations are supported by natural language beyond managing controls, the contents of the MCP guide, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Enable AI agents to interact with Drata. Automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language.
